appDescription: A work assistant for people who work on the road, which logs business driving mileage and turns spoken client meeting notes into records with follow-up tasks.

function.name: MARK_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Mark the most recent recorded trip as business or personal in the mileage log.

function.name: ADD_MEETING_NOTE
function.description: Save what the user said about a client meeting as a meeting record with follow-up tasks.

note.description: The user's spoken account of the meeting.

clientName.description: Name of the client or company the meeting was with.

function.name: ASK_ROADOFFICE
function.description: Answer a question about the user's own work records or read a short briefing for a client, such as how many times a client was visited this month, remaining tasks, the next follow-up date, business mileage, or a summary of past meetings before the next visit.

question.description: The user's question in their own words.
